name: Calculator
highLevelGoals: The user aims to efficiently perform fundamental arithmetic operations (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division) using the smartphone calculator app to quickly obtain accurate results for everyday numerical tasks.
The user desires a simple, clear, and responsive user interface that allows for effortless input of numbers and selection of operations, ensuring a smooth and frustration-free calculation experience.
The user wants the calculation results to be displayed prominently and legibly on the screen, enabling quick verification and understanding of the computed values.
lowLevelGoals: The user will input the initial numerical value into the calculator's display.
The user will choose one of the available arithmetic operations (e.g., +, -, *, /) to apply to the numbers.
The user will input the second numerical value into the calculator's display.
The user will press the equals button or equivalent to execute the selected operation and display the final result.
The user will activate a clear function to reset the calculator's input and display.
The user will interact with the on-screen numerical buttons to input digits into the calculator.
The user will interact with the on-screen operation buttons to choose an arithmetic function.
The user will see a visual or haptic response when pressing a button, confirming the input.
The user will view the numbers and operations entered, as well as any intermediate calculation steps, on the calculator's screen.
The user will locate and read the computed final answer prominently displayed on the calculator's screen.
The user will experience the calculation result displayed with sufficient font size and contrast for easy readability.
